messages:
elaine_sales: Quick one - AcmeFin POC team asked for a clear breach notification SLA to include in their SIG/CAIQ replies. They want hosted vs VPC spelled out and whether a POC can get faster notice.

michael_security: For clarity: hosted (default) = we aim to notify customers of confirmed incidents as soon as practicable and typically within 72 hours of confirmation. Dedicated/Private (VPC/on-prem) or specific contractual commitments (including POC addendums) can include a 24-hour notification target after confirmation. Hosted 24h is not standard ops.

jess_legal: Agreed. Recommended SIG language for answers: "Redwood uses commercially reasonable efforts to notify customers of confirmed security incidents affecting customer data as soon as practicable and generally within 72 hours of confirmation. For Dedicated/Private deployments or where contractually agreed (including POC addendums), Redwood may commit to customer notification within 24 hours of confirmation."

ron_pse: Also provide the escalation path snippet they can paste: "Initial triage (security) -> Customer notification -> CS/AE update -> Exec escalation for Sev1". Keep it simple for legal review.

sam_devops: From ops side here's our internal timeline we give customers when we promise 24h for a POC:
```
T0 = detection/confirmation
T0+0-2h = internal triage + incident ticket
T0+2-8h = containment and mitigation steps
T0+24h = customer notification (if 24h committed) else within 72h
T0+72h = regulatory filings or as-required notifications
```

elaine_sales: Perfect — can you also add a short contact block for the SIG answer for them to reach out if they need realtime updates?

michael_security: Use this block: "Security triage contact: security@redwood.com. POC escalation: ae@redwood.com and poc-ps@redwood.com. Sev1 oncall: provided in contract/addendum."

jess_legal: One more note for the sales playbook: if customer insists on hosted 24h, route to bizops + legal for a priced addendum. Don't promise before approval.

ron_pse: I'll draft a short POC addendum template and estimated ops uplift to attach to the quote if needed.

elaine_sales: Great — I'll update the SIG answers and ping the AE. Thanks all :thumbsup:
